test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Price of five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared. Price of J is less than U, M and N. Price of B is the least. No two cars have the same price. Price of U is less than M. Price of neither U nor M is the highest. Price of how many cars is less than the price of U?
solution:
Given: Price of five cars B, M, J, N and U are compared. No two cars have the same price.

1) Price of B is the least. 

__ > __ > __ > __ > B

2) Price of J is less than U, M and N.

3) Price of neither U nor M is the highest. 

N > U/M > M/U > J > B

4) Price of U is less than M.

N > M > U > J > B

So, Price of '2' cars is less than the price of U.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
